descriptions.ua: We are the Unwavering Artisans, also known as UA. We are driven by a desire to create. We don't care if the art is good. We don't care if anyone likes it. We don't even care if we like it. What matters isn't what we make but that we choose to make it. To create is a divine act, it's good for the soul. And with the death of the artist, even that which you most despise could be the inspiration another artist needs, even if that inspiration comes in the form of "I bet I could do that better..."
descriptions.snide: We are S.N.I.D.E. We are the Society for Nihilistic Intent and Disruptive Efforts. We are the adversary to order. We are the pranksters. We are the fools. We wish to administer a wedgie to the world. We act through the sole desire to reflect the system in a funhouse mirror; to show that everything is a game, and nothing is worth any more than the value it is attributed by the person perceiving it. We have no goals (other than the wedgie thing, which S.N.I.D.E. scientists are working tirelessly in a secret undisclosed underground facility to develop a viable planetary wedgie administering system). We enjoy the game for the game and believe that it in itself is its most valuable reward.
descriptions.na: Not yet sworn to a faction.

index.loggedOutHint: Everyone starts unaffiliated. Earn an invitation through task work to join a faction.

join.confirmSwitch: Join {{faction}}? You won't be able to rejoin {{current}} after leaving.

burned.title: You left {{faction}}
burned.body: Leaving is final for the rest of the era — {{faction}} can't take you back until the next one begins.

sealed.line: You know not what you seek.

letter.headline: Take up the work
letter.pitch: Albescent is an unranked order that keeps what others let slip. Attend the quiet duties, return them well, and leave no trace of yourself in the work. There is no leaderboard here worth minding.

perks.record: A record that survives the keeper

letter.declineError: The order declined, and gave no reason.

plate.provenance: Plate struck {{date}} · station of the Ephemerists, {{rightAscension}} {{declination}}

road.heading: The Road
road.memberTitle: Your name is in the codex
road.eligibleBody: Take a task, triangulate what you find, and submit it to the record. The road is long and forks often.
road.gateTitle: Earn your place on the road

invitation.headline: Walk with the keepers
invitation.pitch: The Ephemerists keep the record of what's true, and true only for now. Take a task, triangulate what you find, and submit it to the codex. The road is long and forks often — walk it with us.

terms.value: a steady hand, an open eye

perks: A codex that weighs your findings for concordance
You gain the power of Time Travel: Enjoy access to tasks of the past, present and future
Your praxis, submitted to the record and remembered

cta.joined: your name is in the codex

roll.heading: THE ROLL
roll.eligibleBody: Anyone willing to put in the shift belongs here. Pick up the work in front of you and finish what you start.

invitation.headline: Join the ranks
invitation.pitch: Anyone willing to put in the shift belongs with the Everymen. No credentials, no gatekeeping — pick up the work in front of you and finish what you start. The roll always has room for one more.
perks: A roll that has your back on every shift
You gain the power of Tireless Determination: The only person you need to beat is yourself. Only you can do the task again, but better this time
Your praxis, logged and counted with the rest

access.heading: ACCESS
access.eligibleBody: Become a node of the array. Run tasks, generate signals, cast them into the consensus. The threshold is already behind us.

invitation.headline: Join the array
invitation.pitch: The threshold is already behind you. Become a node of the array, run tasks, generate signals, and cast them into the consensus. The Singularity does not recruit — it comes online.
perks: A consensus that verifies, coalesces, amplifies
You have learned to Hack the system: This is read only. See what no one else sees
Your praxis, generated and cast to the array

dispatch.eligibleBody: No forms. No gods. No managers. Just show up and mean it.

invitation.headline: Wanna F%&* some S^&* up?
invitation.pitch: No forms. No gods. No managers. S.N.I.D.E. runs on nerve and mischief — you pull off a task, you mean it, and the crew has your back. Show up and make some noise.
perks: A crew that covers for you, not on you
You gain the power of GOING HARD: Duels you win bring glory. Duels you lose bring despair
Your praxis, stamped and filed under 'us'

registry.heading: Those practising
registry.eligibleTitle: Make one true piece a day
registry.eligibleBody: We practise. Not for the badge — for the making itself. Begin whenever you are ready.
registry.confirmSwitch: Begin the practice with {{faction}}? You won't be able to rejoin {{current}} after leaving.
registry.gateTitle: Earn your place at the table

invitation.headline: Make one true piece a day
invitation.pitch: We practise art as a daily, deliberate thing. Every task is a sheet to work on, every praxis a piece you set down and let stand. Not for the badge — for the making itself. Bring something made.
perks: A circle that reads your work closely, and kindly
You gain the power to set your art free: Make a practice of making praxis and you will have points aplenty
Your praxis submitted, and held up

cta.joined: a seat is kept for you

join.heading: the circle
join.eligibleBody: You've done the work — welcome home, witch.

invitation.headline: Come be a little magic
invitation.pitch: Cozy Coven is World Zero's circle for the soft and the strange. No spectators here — only witches mid-spell. Take a task, do the tiny brave thing, and let the circle cheer you on.
perks: A coven that cheers every tiny victory
You gain The Power of Friendship: Witches that task together will always find a little extra magic ✦
Your praxis, submitted and hearted by the circle

join.heading: THE MUSTER
join.eligibleBody: the armour is one-size, the oath is for life

invitation.headline: Take up the noodle sword
invitation.pitch: By decree most official (we made the seal ourselves), thou art summoned to the Warriors of Whimsy. Bring a straight face. We shall supply the sword.

terms.label: oath of fealty
terms.value: one task, met with a straight face
none — the Court supplies the sword

perks: The Leap of Whimsy — once each level, a knight may storm a single task one rung above their station and take it anyway

mobile.unaffiliatedBody: Every path is open. Each faction watches its own work — do enough of it, and an invitation finds you.
mobile.gateHint: An invitation to {{faction}} is earned. Keep completing tasks.
mobile.burnedHint: You left {{faction}}, and it can't take you back until the next era begins.
